name: backend
description: This project was bootstrapped with Fastify-CLI.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test -r ts-node/register ${TEST_FILES:-./test/unit/**/*.test.ts}
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test -r ts-node/register ${TEST_FILES:-./test/integration/*.test.ts}
scripts.start: rimraf dist && npm run build:ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development && fastify start -p 8002 -l info dist/app.js
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production && fastify start -l info dist/app.js
scripts.dev: npm run delete:dist && npm run build:ts && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "TypeScript,App" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm:watch:ts" "npm:dev:start"
